memories.content: The CFO pushed back on the original marketing budget, leading to an eight percent reduction. They have a decent working relationship with the CMO and meet weekly. They are aware the offsite agenda includes the campaign as a topic.

The marketing team's revised Q4 budget is eight percent below the original ask. The CFO and CMO meet weekly and work together decently.
